purpose: Validate starting conditions and reproducibility without live providers or production gameplay changes.
objective_status: MACHINE PREREQUISITES VERIFIED; NARRATIVE DELIVERY PARTIALLY VERIFIED; AWAIT REVIEW
executive_summary: All ten scenarios have verified machine prerequisites in frozen frontier-gate-v1. S07 and S09 opening delivery remains partially verified; narrative assumptions remain unverified in every scenario. No blocked scenario in the intact baseline. Repeated resets are equivalent. Focused checks: 24 passed; adjacent regression: 49 passed. Replaced mutable working-data bootstrap with a pinned snapshot of an existing replay fixture and defaults; preflight blocks missing or incompatible prerequisites before chat. No production gameplay change, live evaluation, performance score, generalization claim or new Product Realization campaign. Failure class: evaluation instrument setup. Await review before ATGB-03.

production: None. Production reset and gameplay semantics unchanged. Canonical data preserved.
validation: 24 readiness/infrastructure tests pass, including repeated resets and rejection paths.
tooling: Frozen baseline validator, preflight before chat, preflight-only CLI, separate result reporting; workspace temporary stores.
documentation: Readiness matrix, execution instructions, explicit S07 partition supersession notes and NEXT_SESSION update.
generated_artifacts: Provider-disabled preflight of all ten scenarios; validation results and logs. No gameplay performance evidence.

testing.focused: 24 passed. Existing S06 host-chat regression submits four ordered turns with all providers disabled; repeated initialization test resets 10 scenarios twice without chat.
testing.broader: 49 passed: playability evaluator, review-handoff and validation-evidence-standard tests.
testing.runtime_validation: 20 repeated isolated resets plus final 10-scenario preflight. Same normalized state hash. No live evaluation.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Providers disabled; no model evaluation or gameplay scoring. No live run authorized.
testing.new_regressions: None observed in the validated scope.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Sandbox socketpair initialization timeout and transient atomic rename denial are preserved as environmental attempts; final authorized provider-disabled tests passed.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Accept the frozen baseline and readiness limitations before ATGB-03. No live baseline authorized by this package.

campaign_specific: S07/S09 opening context is authored but delivery not verified by silent reset.
Narrative assumptions remain unverified for all scenarios.
Windows sandbox blocks local asyncio socketpair startup; authorized provider-disabled test run passed outside sandbox.
pre_existing: PR-BL versus later PR-EG session orientation remains unreconciled.

missing_concepts: Live baseline with human rubric review (not authorized here).
Opening context delivery evidence for S07 and S09.
recommended_next_step: Stop. Review readiness matrix and baseline. Await review before ATGB-03; do not initiate live evaluation or a Product Realization campaign.
